capabilities.target: platform-resolved owner-private vault-pm roots or one explicit portable-import source
capabilities.justification: Composes the audited local host and filesystem storage adapters to read durable local vault state or one bounded encrypted portable artifact.
Composes the audited local host and filesystem storage adapters to persist durable local vault and encrypted item state.

capabilities.target: platform-resolved owner-private vault-pm roots or one explicit portable-export destination
capabilities.justification: Creates first-use private roots, configuration, journals, bootstraps, encrypted immutable records, or one create-new already-encrypted portable artifact selected by the user.
VLT-PM41 appends ordinal, phase, and step-name lines to an owner-only, symlink-refusing file the drill names. No key, namespace, object identifier, path, title, or ciphertext can reach it.

capabilities.target: controlling terminal and operating-system entropy APIs
capabilities.justification: Collects bounded login fields and hidden secrets from the controlling terminal and fills generation-zero and item randomness from the OS CSPRNG.

VLT-PM41 crash injection reads the durable-step ordinal to stop at and the path of the metadata-only step ledger. This authority exists only in this instrumented twin; the shipped rust/vault-pm-cli-program executable never names the feature that compiles the read.

VLT-PM41 removes this process with SIGKILL at the chosen durable write so a drill can observe what an uncatchable interruption leaves on disk. The signal is sent to the caller's own process id and to no other.
Supplies advisory generation-zero and item mutation timestamps.
Writes only the bounded public output and fixed payload-free errors returned by the CLI package.

justification: Instrumented twin of the local password-manager CLI, built and used only by the VLT-PM41 crash/fault drill. It carries the shipped executable's capability profile plus the three the drill needs: reading its two injection variables, removing its own process, and appending a metadata-only durable-step ledger. It is not a product executable, is never installed, and its binary is deliberately named vault-pm-drill so it cannot be mistaken for the product.
